scope: Eight reusable project-authored material studies. Manufacturer photographs are linked, not redistributed. Optical parameters, fixture shapes and unmeasured calipers are estimates until reviewed against the linked photographs; successful rendering is not acceptance.

cases.title: Cotton / stock calipers
cases.specification: Gmund Cotton Max White: pure cotton; 600 g/m². The manufacturer's printing guide describes approximately 1 mm thickness at 600 g/m². This is a published approximate caliper, not a measurement of this sample.
geometry_variants: single 600 gsm sheet, published approximate 1.0 mm
three offset 300 gsm study sheets, estimated 0.5 mm each
review: matte diffuse body
subtle irregular fibers at close view
approximately 1 mm edge
soft contact shadows without plastic highlights
0.5 mm estimated sheet edge is visibly thinner than the 1.0 mm sheet; stacking must not conceal individual calipers

photograph_review.method: Original manufacturer/supplier pixels inspected; PDFs rasterized privately. No copyrighted photograph redistributed.
photograph_review.silhouette: Source is a flat face crop; there is no edge or sheet silhouette to infer. Use the published approximate caliper separately.
photograph_review.surface: Fine irregular nondirectional tooth with shallow soft shadows; no regular woven grid or large fibers. White has small low-contrast mottling.
photograph_review.optical: Broad diffuse response, no tight specular streak in this illumination.
photograph_review.unknown: Photo has no metric ruler, back face, or controlled light. Absolute tooth amplitude/spacing and BRDF cannot be measured.

variant_overrides.estimate_notes: The 300 gsm / 0.5 mm thinner-stock variant is an authored comparison assumption, not a measured sample or a manufacturer caliper claim. The Gmund source offers a 300 gsm grade; this study assigns 0.5 mm to test an explicit caliper change. Three independent sheets retain 0.5 mm each.

cases.title: Cotton / ink, impression and foil
cases.specification: Same published cotton stock as the plain case. Letterpress, blind relief and foil geometry are authored studies; impression depth 0.12 mm and foil height 0.02 mm are explicit unmeasured design choices.
review: ink stays registered over stock texture
compressed shoulders cast directional shadows
blind source does not print as black
foil highlights remain inside the source mask

photograph_review.method: Original manufacturer/supplier pixels inspected; PDFs rasterized privately. No copyrighted photograph redistributed.
photograph_review.silhouette: Additional Gmund photograph shows four separate thin cards at oblique angles above a gray background. Card corners are lightly rounded; material edges are finite.
photograph_review.surface: Letterpress source shows fine black outlined printed curves and flat blue/orange regions with subtle stock texture. Additional card photo shows circular blind depressions with light upper rims and shaded lower shoulders.
photograph_review.optical: Orange and pink circular foil regions have bright localized glints and darker saturated portions, distinct from the matte white stock. Finishing boundaries stay crisp.
photograph_review.unknown: Photographed foil cards are an application example, not a measured Gmund Cotton sample. No exact card caliper, impression depth or metallic BRDF is supplied.

cases.estimate_notes: The foil film suppresses inherited paper donor micro-normal and bump detail only inside its existing artwork mask (normalStrength=0, bumpStrength=0). This is an artist estimate after the previous final highlight showed excessive hammered/glitter-like grain compared with the linked smooth Gmund foil field. Stock tooth, caliper, relief geometry, foil roughness0.17, metallic1, coat0.25 and coat roughness0.08 remain unchanged.

cases.title: Vellum / overlapping sheets
cases.specification: Neenah CLEARFOLD 113 g/m²: 3.7 point caliper = 0.09398 mm; published opacity 28. Opacity is a paper test result, not shader alpha or transmission. The Printswell photograph is a related 40 bond vellum, not the identical Neenah stock.
review: underlying graphic partly visible
overlap becomes denser
transmitted light remains soft
physical edge is not a glass slab

photograph_review.method: Original manufacturer/supplier pixels inspected; PDFs rasterized privately. No copyrighted photograph redistributed.
photograph_review.silhouette: Loose translucent rectangular overlay above a printed invitation; edges are slight and a top eyelet holds the layers.
photograph_review.surface: Underlying photograph and border remain visible with reduced contrast; the overlay has a pale milky cast. Black foreground lettering stays relatively crisp.
photograph_review.optical: Diffusive transmission washes underlying dark colors. This is neither opaque paper nor clear glass.
photograph_review.unknown: Photograph uses related Printswell 40 bond vellum, not the exact CLEARFOLD113gsm stock. Layer gap, lighting, and measured transmission are unknown.

cases.estimate_notes: Neutral #F4F4F4 base tint is an artist estimate chosen after direct comparison with the related supplier vellum photograph, not a measured CLEARFOLD color. Earlier #F4F2E9 outputs are retained because they showed an excessive yellow-olive cast. Transmission, scattering radii, roughness, caliper, geometry and lighting are held unchanged for the controlled tint comparison.

cases.title: Woven / linen-cotton
cases.specification: Robert Kaufman Essex Yarn Dyed E064-843: 55% linen / 45% cotton; 5.6 oz/yd² (derived 189.9 g/m²); width 43 inches. 0.4 mm caliper is an estimate. Poly Haven rough_linen is a different CC0 scanned fabric used for estimated normal/roughness response, not a scan of Essex. Current map extent is the published 270.708 × 271.300 mm donor scan; normal strength 0.3 is an optical estimate. The current official 4K donor sources were imported using native max_dimension 4096, yielding 4087 × 4096 pixel assets within the existing 16 MP output budget. Original source and returned derived hashes are retained separately; the published physical repeat is preserved. The saved analytic drape uses 96 by 40 cells with its original dimensions, UV orientation and fold equation. Geometry sampling is distinct from the donor texture resolution and estimated optical values.
geometry_variants: shallow broad drape with 0 degree weave mapping
deep returned-edge drape with 90 degree weave and tangent rotation
review: interlaced structure at close view
broad matte folds
small grazing sheen
texture does not swim across the drape
90 degree material orientation changes the mapped weave and directional reflection while physical repeat size and mesh UVs stay fixed

photograph_review.method: Original manufacturer/supplier pixels inspected; PDFs rasterized privately. No copyrighted photograph redistributed.
photograph_review.silhouette: Manufacturer image is a flat fabric close-up with no drape or edge evidence. Authored folds are test geometry rather than a literal silhouette match.
photograph_review.surface: Fine orthogonal interlacing with subtly irregular yarn widths and tiny tan/cream color variations; very small dark interstices.
photograph_review.optical: Mostly matte body, low contrast at individual intersections, no satin-like extended streaks.
photograph_review.unknown: The image has no scale ruler. Physical texture repeat is a donor-map assumption and must be visually compared rather than called a measured Essex scan.

variant_overrides.estimate_notes: This authored material variant rotates the donor normal/roughness texture mapping 90 degrees and the anisotropic tangent by one quarter turn. Mesh UVs, surface dimensions and the published 270.708 × 271.300 mm donor repeat are unchanged. This is a material orientation test, not a distinct manufacturer product or measured BRDF.

cases.title: Satin / silk charmeuse
cases.specification: Dharma Charmeuse: 100% crepe-back silk satin, 19.5 momme (the page's mm notation is not millimeters); approximate derived mass 84.6 g/m². Thickness, optical coefficients and fold dimensions are estimates. Satin and textured crepe back are distinct faces. Poly Haven crepe_satin normal/roughness/anisotropy maps are a different CC0 satin donor at its published 263.199 × 267.900 mm extent, not a scan of Dharma silk. The white base color and stated optical estimates are retained. The current project-authored rest shape has compound diagonal folds, a tucked valley and a turnback. Normal strength 0.15 is an optical estimate that subordinates donor grain. The published donor repeat and 0.18 mm estimated caliper are preserved.
review: long directional highlight
highlight changes with viewing direction
smooth drape silhouette
soft textile response without metallic mirror color
distinct rougher crepe reverse on returned edge
finite 0.18 mm estimated caliper at fold boundary
whole-fold family includes a compound broad bend and narrower tucked valley, with smooth thin-cloth transitions rather than only a uniform barrel
broad pearlescent highlight bands retain soft shoulders, local narrow rims and dark troughs without clipped white rails
macro detail is fine and subordinate to the smooth satin response; map upload alone does not establish textile fidelity

photograph_review.method: Original manufacturer/supplier pixels inspected; PDFs rasterized privately. No copyrighted photograph redistributed.
photograph_review.silhouette: Draped white silk has broad curved folds interspersed with narrower tucked valleys, one large oblique central fold and small curled return edges.
photograph_review.surface: Fine surface texture is subdued at whole-fabric scale; folds remain smooth and continuous rather than faceted.
photograph_review.optical: Pearlescent broad light bands transition to narrower bright fold rims and darker troughs. Highlights follow local fold direction.
photograph_review.unknown: Photograph does not clearly isolate the crepe back; a rougher reverse is supported by the product description, not a measured reverse-side photograph.

cases.title: Jersey / organic cotton
cases.specification: Organic Cotton Plus Jersey SKU 15734-03 60: 100% organic cotton, 190 g/m²; declared stretch 25% crosswise / 20% lengthwise. The rest shape is authored, not a calibrated mechanics simulation. 0.65 mm caliper is estimated. Poly Haven cotton_jersey is a different CC0 scanned fabric, with normal/roughness maps applied at its published 263.603 × 263.800 mm extent. Normal strength 1 preserves the donor normal field amplitude for a controlled comparison with the earlier 0.35 estimate; all optical response assignments remain estimates. The current official 4K donor sources were imported using native max_dimension 4096, yielding 4093 × 4096 pixel assets within the existing 16 MP output budget. Original source and returned derived hashes are retained separately; the published physical repeat is preserved. The saved analytic drape uses 96 by 40 cells with its original dimensions, UV orientation and fold equation. Geometry sampling is distinct from the donor texture resolution and estimated optical values.
review: visible loop courses and wales
soft rounded folds
matte center with grazing fuzz
variant actually changes width and loop spacing

photograph_review.method: Original manufacturer/supplier pixels inspected; PDFs rasterized privately. No copyrighted photograph redistributed.
photograph_review.silhouette: Soft broad vertical folds with irregular shallow creases; rounded fold ridges and narrow draped valleys.
photograph_review.surface: Warm off-white face with tiny darker flecks and faint fine directional structure, not a chunky rope knit.
photograph_review.optical: Very broad matte gradients and little sharp specular contrast. Knit should remain visibly less lustrous than satin under a shared key light.
photograph_review.unknown: Loop spacing and caliper cannot be read from this unscaled image. Procedural loop field and rest shape remain explicit estimates.

cases.title: Thread / matte polyester
cases.specification: Madeira Frosted Matt 40: polyester; dtex 90 x 2; current product page stitch spacing 0.35–0.40 mm (flyer gives approximately 0.3–0.4 mm). Render diameter 0.22 mm is an estimate, not inferred from linear mass. The current authored visual comparison uses 0.24 mm satin/fill spacing, matching the lustrous program exactly; editable 0.40 mm baselines are retained. This denser comparison is an artist choice outside the stated manufacturer recommendation, not a measured optimum.
geometry_variants: fill with underlay and real crossing
review: independent rounded strands
distinct strand entry points and crossing shadows
no thread across jumps
low directional highlight relative to lustrous case
paired matte/lustrous source stitch positions, radius, methods, underlay and tie settings match exactly
matte remains visibly less directional than lustrous under identical relative camera and highlight light, while rounded strands retain shading
fill/underlay stays close to the substrate with clearance localized around crossings; no tall ladder of inflated arches

photograph_review.method: Original manufacturer/supplier pixels inspected; PDFs rasterized privately. No copyrighted photograph redistributed.
photograph_review.silhouette: Brochure page3 shows raised crossed neon stitches over coarse dark cloth. Page5 shows a pink satin-stitched figure with white rectangular glasses, visibly above a black woven backing.
photograph_review.surface: Individual short strands and needle turns remain legible, including uneven satin-column edges and crossing order. Thread is not a printed continuous stripe.
photograph_review.optical: Pink and white strands keep broad mostly uniform color, with small rounded highlights rather than bright longitudinal streaks.
photograph_review.unknown: FrostedMatt40 page3 spacing0.3–0.4mm is a manufacturer recommendation, not a physical diameter. Page5 weight is not labeled, so use only qualitative response/strand evidence.

cases.comparison_spacing_note: Both matte and lustrous active specimens use identical 0.24 mm satin/fill spacing, source shapes, methods, underlay, 0.22 mm estimated diameter and tie settings. Separate editable 0.40 mm baseline iterations and actual before/after needle programs are retained. Running spacing remains 0.40 mm. The denser spacing is an authored visual comparison outside the manufacturer recommendation, not a calibrated sew-out setting.
cases.comparison_tie_note: Both active appearances use one 0.7 mm backtracking repeat (two stitches per tie), with tie-in and tie-off enabled. The previous two-repeat definitions, exported needle commands, and rendered evidence remain retained. Every non-tie command is unchanged. Compact raised knots are accepted for the authored noncompressing round-strand model; this is not calibrated tie mechanics or a validated sew-out.

review_notices: Historical candidate2 renders predate a correction to bundled Cycles sRGB texture decoding. Their color-texture, artwork and backing contrast cannot establish final material fidelity. Raw normal/roughness data remains diagnostic evidence. Affected current views must be rendered again with the corrected helper before acceptance; earlier failures and observations stay visible.
